heights.name: Welle walking floor (OSM level 1)
heights.method: NOT directly measurable (covered). Bounds: the Welle body underside in swissBUILDINGS3D is 546.43 m (5.69 rel.), so the floor is above that, probably about 547.0-547.5 m (+6.3..+6.8); it meets the Schanzenbrücke whose deck rises from 547.2 m (south end) to 552 m (north end). The builder's +6.5 m is consistent.
heights.source: derived from © swisstopo swissBUILDINGS3D / swissSURFACE3D and OSM level tag

heights.name: Open stair down to the Neuengassunterführung (Bollwerk): lowest visible ground
heights.method: lowest swissSURFACE3D ground returns in the open stairwell; the stair continues under cover, so the underpass floor is at or below this value

heights.name: Open stair down to the Christoffelunterführung (Bahnhofplatz): lowest visible ground

heights.name: Construction pit at Bubenbergplatz / Hirschengraben (2023)
heights.method: p5 of swissSURFACE3D ground returns in the excavation next to Haus Bubenberg (new Bubenberg access / RBS works, state 2023). Not a finished floor, but shows how deep the works reach.

heights.name: Underground building under Grosse Schanze (OSM: Institute Exakte Wissenschaften, level -3)
heights.method: swissBUILDINGS3D object "Unterirdisches Gebaeude" (EGID 504010651): z range 544.1-561.8 m. Its lowest vertex is the modelled bottom, not a surveyed floor. Not part of the station.

not_measurable.why: Covered; the survey (AV) stores no heights for underground buildings; swissBUILDINGS3D has no station underground. Only an upper bound from open stairwells (-4.01 / -2.86 m rel., see stair_bottom_*). Builder value -4.8 m is consistent (below both bounds).
Fully underground; no height in the survey, swissBUILDINGS3D or SBB data. OSM only gives level=-2 / layer=-2.

not_measurable.what: Platform level inside the covered hall
not_measurable.why: Not visible from the air; assumed equal to the open platform ends (station tracks are level; per-track medians agree within a few cm).

not_measurable.what: Underside of the deck over the platforms
not_measurable.why: Not visible; swissBUILDINGS3D extrudes the deck walls down to the terrain model. A slab of about 1.5 m is assumed in shell.geojson.
